messages.content: Hi there! Thanks for taking the time to chat with me today. I’m really looking forward to learning more about what you want to achieve with the mobile app modernisation. To start off, could you tell me about the high-level goals you have for the new app? What do you hope it will accomplish?

Hey! Thanks for having me. So, I guess my main goal is to have an app that just feels more modern and works faster, you know? I want to be able to see my transactions right away—like, I want to know when money leaves my account without having to wait around. Also, if I ever lose my card, it would be great to just freeze it instantly without having to call anyone. That kind of stuff makes a big difference for me.

Thanks for sharing that! So, if I understand correctly, you want the app to feel modern and operate faster. You also mentioned wanting real-time transaction notifications and the ability to instantly freeze your card if it's lost. 

Could you tell me a bit more about what "feeling modern" means to you? What specific features or design elements do you think contribute to that feeling?

Yeah, "feeling modern" is just about everything being smooth and easy to use. Like, I love how Revolut has a clean design and everything is just there when you need it. I want to see all my accounts in one place, and it should be super easy to navigate. Just quick access to what I need, you know? And maybe some cool features like spending breakdowns or setting budgets would be nice too, but it’s more about the overall look and feel.

Got it! So, you’re looking for a smooth, easy-to-use experience with a clean design where you can see all your accounts in one place. You also mentioned quick navigation and possibly some features like spending breakdowns and budget settings, but the overall look and feel is the priority for you.

Are there any limitations or restrictions that we should be aware of when designing these features? For example, any regulatory requirements or technical constraints?

I haven't really thought about any of the technical stuff or regulations. I just want to focus on getting an app that works well and looks good. If there are any rules or limitations, that's not really on my radar. I’m just hoping for something that feels fresh and fast, you know?

Thanks for clarifying that! So, you want to prioritize a fresh and fast app experience without getting into the technical or regulatory details right now.

Can you give me an example of a feature from another app that you really like? What about it do you find helpful or appealing?

Sure! I really like how Revolut shows me my spending in different categories. It’s super helpful because I can see where my money is going at a glance. I also like that I get instant notifications when I spend. Just knowing right away what’s happening with my money is a big deal for me. It keeps everything clear and makes managing my finances easier.

That makes a lot of sense! So, you appreciate features like spending categories that give you a quick overview of your finances, along with instant notifications for your spending. These features help you manage your money more effectively.

Just to confirm, you want the new app to include spending categorization and instant notifications for transactions, right?
Yeah, exactly! Those features are really important to me. I want to see where my money goes and know right away when I spend something. It just makes everything a lot easier to handle.

Great! So far, we have a few clear requirements: 

1. The app should have a modern and clean design that offers smooth usability.
2. Users should be able to see all their accounts in one place for quick access.
3. The app should provide real-time transaction notifications.
4. Users should be able to instantly freeze their card if it's lost.
5. The app should include spending categorization to help users see where their money is going.

Thanks for your input! If there’s anything else you think of later, feel free to reach out.
